# Orbital Matte Glass Spec

> [!NOTE]
> High-opacity glass keeps `APCA Lc >= 70` over pure `#FFFFFF` and `#000000` backdrops.

## Contrast Thresholds

- **Primary Prose**: `>= 75` (*strict floor*)
- **Reference**: [Design System](https://antigravity.google/docs/changelog.md)

| Layer | Opacity | Blur |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Shell | `0.86` | `24px` |
